description: Offline search index for the Pulse SDK documentation site. Consumed identically to the inline <script id="pulse-doc-index"> blocks embedded in sdk.html and internal.html — this standalone copy exists for external tooling (e.g. static-site search crawlers, IDE doc-search plugins) that prefer a fetchable JSON asset over parsing embedded script tags.

entries.title: Installation
entries.body: The package is pure ESM and requires the global fetch API so Node.js 18 or newer is the practical minimum. Install with npm install pnpm add yarn add or bun add. The package ships its own TypeScript declarations, no separate types package is needed. It bundles the full OpenTelemetry instrumentation set. Prisma client and bullmq are optional peer dependencies.

entries.title: Quick Start
entries.body: createSDK is exactly equivalent to calling init. The API key is the only required option and is not read automatically from an environment variable. Minimal example uses createSDK with apiKey then captureError in a try catch. Initialize the SDK before requiring any library you want auto instrumented.

entries.title: Configuration apiKey and options
entries.body: SDKInitOptions fields include apiKey which is required, a non-empty credential rejected if empty or containing control characters. baseUrl overrides the control plane origin, must be a bare HTTP origin, also overridable via SDK_BASE_URL environment variable. maxBreadcrumbs default 100 validated range 0 to 1000. shutdownTimeoutMs default 10000 validated range 1000 to 60000. debug defaults false. The options object is validated by a strict Zod schema, unknown keys are rejected.

entries.title: Auto Features overview
entries.body: Automatic HTTP HTTPS tracing creates spans for outgoing requests once instrumentation http is enabled remotely and the tracing entitlement is active. Express and Fastify request capture emits a discrete request event per handled request. Database cache queue instrumentation covers MongoDB Redis PostgreSQL MySQL2 Prisma BullMQ. Automatic error capture handles uncaughtException unhandledRejection and console error. Automatic console log capture intercepts console log info warn error debug.

entries.title: captureError signature and behavior
entries.body: captureError returns void and never throws. Parameters include severity default error, fingerprint to override auto generated grouping, context for additional data, mechanism defaulting to manual. Stack parsing and fingerprint generation run synchronously. Fingerprints are cached for 60 seconds. Errors use minimum batch size of 1 on their route so they are sent within about one second. A killed disableErrors killswitch makes this a complete no-op.

entries.title: captureMetric and metric helpers
entries.body: captureMetric supports counter gauge histogram, defaulting to gauge if type is omitted. incrementCounter setGauge recordHistogram addUpDownCounter are convenience functions. Metrics are aggregated using OpenTelemetry exponential histograms, percentiles are computed downstream by the backend, not by the SDK. High cardinality label keys like userId requestId email are always stripped.

entries.title: Tracing withSpan and startSpan
entries.body: withSpan is the preferred custom span API, it installs the span as the active span for the callback async lifetime so child work correctly nests under it, records thrown errors, rethrows the original error, and always ends the span exactly once. startSpan returns a PulseSpan but does not make it the active span. A timeoutMs option force-ends the span with error status but does not cancel the underlying async work.

entries.title: SDK Lifecycle flush and shutdown
entries.body: flush drains the pipeline flushes every transport route and flushes persistent storage without tearing down any subsystem, safe to call anytime. shutdown rejects new captures tears down every subsystem flushes what it can persists whatever could not be delivered and resets all global state, it never throws and always resolves with a ShutdownResult.

entries.title: Troubleshooting why errors do not appear
entries.body: Confirm createSDK resolved to a defined value not undefined, the API key is correct, features errors and the errors entitlement are both active, and killswitches disableErrors disableSDK are not set. Check getSDKHealth circuitState for the errors route.

entries.title: How do I enable verbose logs
entries.body: Beyond debug true, two undocumented environment variables exist in the codebase, PULSE_TRANSPORT_CONSOLE which dumps transport request response details with the Authorization header redacted, and PULSE_SDK_CONSOLE_DEBUG which dumps general pipeline event debug output.

entries.title: FAQ sampling delivery and jitter
entries.body: Delivery is at least once not exactly once, the backend must deduplicate by eventId. Compression is always gzip for the primary telemetry send path. There is no retry jitter, retry delay is a deterministic function of backoff strategy and attempt number. HTTP statuses 5xx 429 408 trigger a retry, other 4xx are permanent failures and are not persisted to disk.

entries.title: Security API keys and PII
entries.body: API keys are validated as non-empty and free of control characters before transmission. Never hardcode API keys in source. Body capture is off by default. Client IPs are hashed not raw by default. Authorization Cookie Set-Cookie X-API-Key and Proxy-Authorization are redacted by a hardcoded default list. Bodies larger than 64 KB are marked truncated rather than fully attached.

entries.title: Architecture Overview
entries.body: The SDK is built around one idea, the backend is the sole source of runtime policy. A validated immutable configuration snapshot is fetched exactly once at boot and every subsystem sampling killswitches entitlements limits transport routing privacy scrubbing instrumentation selection reads from that one frozen object. The snapshot can later be atomically replaced never merged by a second event driven refresh.

entries.title: SDK Boot Sequence
entries.body: createSDK wraps init. Boot performs exactly one network operation, a single POST to the control plane, with the API key sent via an HTTP header not the JSON body. The response is validated by a hand written structural validator, hashed, and deep frozen.

entries.title: Complete Event Lifecycle
entries.body: All ten SDKEvent shapes converge on one function enqueueEvent. Synchronous gates shutdown state killswitch load shedder pre-init buffering in-flight cap run first and can reject cheaply before any async work is scheduled.

entries.title: Batching Architecture
entries.body: Each of the 10 event type routes owns its own bounded queue and BatchManager. A batch flushes at maxBatchSize or maxWaitTimeMs whichever comes first. Minimum batch sizes are hardcoded per route.

entries.title: Sampling FNV-1a deterministic
entries.body: All sampling is deterministic, an FNV-1a 32 bit hash of a stable identifier normalized to 0 to 1 and compared against a configured rate. There is no Math random anywhere in the sampling path.

entries.title: Retry Architecture backoff and jitter
entries.body: Retry eligible failures are network errors and HTTP 5xx 429 408, any other 4xx is a permanent rejection that is dropped not persisted. Backoff is exponential linear or fixed depending on remote config, with no jitter, a confirmed gap noted in the repository audit.

entries.title: Shutdown single-flight and unconditional cleanup
entries.body: shutdown is single flight and races its real cleanup against a timeout, if the deadline wins cleanup keeps running in the background and a subsequent init waits for it. An unconditional cleanup phase always runs regardless of orchestrated phase success.

entries.title: Design Decisions tradeoffs
entries.body: Immutable snapshot no merge, fallback only persistence, deterministic sampling, direct to stream internal logging to break a real observed console interception feedback loop, separated features killswitches entitlements axes, and OTel native metrics.
